description: Medical-history intake script derived from the IRDAI-standard Arogya Sanjeevani health insurance proposal form. Every Indian insurer must offer this product with identical wording, which makes it the canonical reference for a health underwriting call. Source: Care Health Insurance (UIN RHIHLIP20154V011920) and SBI General (UIN SBIHLIP20180V011920) proposal forms.
sourceDocuments: Care Health Insurance - Arogya Sanjeevani Proposal Form (IRDAI Reg. 148)
SBI General Insurance - Arogya Sanjeevani Proposal Form (IRDAI Reg. 144)

items.label: identity_confirm
items._promptNote: English opens with 'Hello', not 'Namaste'. The bilingual greeting before the language choice does open with नमस्ते - deliberately, because a caller who has not yet chosen a language understands it either way - but once the caller has said English, greeting them in Hindi reads as the agent not having listened. Hindi and Hinglish keep नमस्ते, where it is correct.
items.prompt: Hello, this is a medical information call on behalf of {{insurerName}} regarding your health policy application {{policyNumber}}. Am I speaking with {{customerName}}?
items.promptHi: नमस्ते, मैं {{insurerName}} की ओर से आपकी स्वास्थ्य बीमा पॉलिसी {{policyNumber}} के बारे में चिकित्सा जानकारी के लिए कॉल कर रही हूँ। क्या मैं {{customerName}} से बात कर रही हूँ?
items.promptHinglish: Namaste, main {{insurerName}} ki taraf se aapki health policy {{policyNumber}} ke liye medical information lene ke liye call kar rahi hoon. Kya main {{customerName}} se baat kar rahi hoon?
items.reprompt: Sorry, I did not catch that. Am I speaking with {{customerName}}?

items.label: recording_consent
items.prompt: Thank you. This call is recorded and the information is used only to underwrite your policy. It will take about five minutes. Please answer as completely and accurately as you can - if something is left out or is incorrect, the policy can be cancelled or a claim declined later, and premiums are not refundable in that case. Do I have your consent to continue?
items.promptHi: धन्यवाद। यह कॉल रिकॉर्ड की जा रही है और जानकारी का उपयोग केवल आपकी पॉलिसी के अंडरराइटिंग के लिए किया जाएगा। इसमें लगभग पाँच मिनट लगेंगे। कृपया पूरी और सही जानकारी दें - कुछ छूट जाए या गलत हो, तो आगे पॉलिसी रद्द हो सकती है या क्लेम अस्वीकार हो सकता है, और उस स्थिति में प्रीमियम वापस नहीं होता। क्या मुझे आगे बढ़ने की अनुमति है?
items.promptHinglish: Dhanyavaad. Yeh call record ho rahi hai aur information sirf aapki policy underwriting ke liye use hogi. Paanch minute lagenge. Kripya poori aur sahi jaankari dijiye - kuch chhoot jaye ya galat ho, to aage policy cancel ho sakti hai ya claim reject ho sakta hai, aur us case mein premium refund nahi hota. Kya main aage badh sakti hoon?
items.complianceNote: DPDP: explicit informed consent captured before any health data is processed. The non-disclosure consequences are stated here because the insurer's telephonic report records them as read out to the customer by the doctor, and the written transcript we send repeats them - saying it only in the email would mean the customer was never actually told.

items.label: dob_verify
items.prompt: For verification, could you confirm your date of birth?
items.promptHi: सत्यापन के लिए, क्या आप अपनी जन्म तिथि बता सकते हैं?
items.promptHinglish: Verification ke liye, apni date of birth bata dijiye?

items.label: height_cm
items.prompt: Let us start with two basics. What is your height?
items.promptHi: दो बुनियादी बातों से शुरू करें। आपकी लंबाई कितनी है?
items.promptHinglish: Do basic cheezon se shuru karein. Aapki height kitni hai?
items.reprompt: Your height, in feet and inches or in centimetres?

items.label: weight_kg
items.prompt: And your current weight in kilograms?
items.promptHi: और आपका वर्तमान वजन किलोग्राम में?
items.promptHinglish: Aur aapka current weight kitne kilo hai?

items.label: cancer_tumor
items.prompt: I will now go through a short list of medical conditions. Please say yes or no to each. First, have you ever been diagnosed with cancer, a tumour, polyp or cyst?
items.promptHi: अब मैं कुछ बीमारियों की सूची पूछूँगी। कृपया हाँ या ना में उत्तर दें। पहला, क्या आपको कभी कैंसर, ट्यूमर, पॉलिप या सिस्ट का निदान हुआ है?
items.promptHinglish: Ab main kuch bimariyon ki list poochhungi, sirf haan ya na bataiye. Pehla, kya aapko kabhi cancer, tumour, polyp ya cyst hua hai?

items.label: cardiac
items.prompt: Any heart disease or disorder, chest pain or discomfort, or irregular heartbeat?
items.promptHi: कोई हृदय रोग, सीने में दर्द या बेचैनी, या अनियमित धड़कन?
items.promptHinglish: Koi heart disease, seene mein dard ya discomfort, ya irregular heartbeat?

items.label: hypertension_cholesterol
items.prompt: Hypertension, high blood pressure, or high cholesterol?
items.promptHi: उच्च रक्तचाप या कोलेस्ट्रॉल की समस्या?
items.promptHinglish: High BP ya cholesterol ki problem?

items.label: respiratory
items.prompt: Asthma, tuberculosis, COPD, pleural effusion, bronchitis, or any other lung condition?
items.promptHi: अस्थमा, टीबी, सीओपीडी, ब्रोंकाइटिस, या फेफड़ों की कोई अन्य बीमारी?
items.promptHinglish: Asthma, TB, COPD, bronchitis, ya lungs ki koi aur bimari?

items.label: endocrine
items.prompt: Thyroid disease, Cushing's disease, parathyroid or Addison's disease?
items.promptHi: थायरॉइड, कुशिंग, पैराथायरॉइड या एडिसन रोग?
items.promptHinglish: Thyroid, Cushing's, parathyroid ya Addison's disease?

items.label: diabetes
items.prompt: Diabetes, high blood sugar, or are you on insulin or diabetes medication?
items.promptHi: मधुमेह, उच्च रक्त शर्करा, या आप इंसुलिन या शुगर की दवा लेते हैं?
items.promptHinglish: Diabetes, sugar ki problem, ya aap insulin ya sugar ki dawa lete hain?
items.notes: Highest-frequency positive in the Indian market. Colloquial forms: 'sugar', 'sugar ki bimari', 'madhumeh'. OpenSearch k-NN must map all of these to E11.

items.label: neuromuscular
items.prompt: Motor neuron disease, muscular dystrophy, myasthenia gravis, or any other neuromuscular condition?
items.promptHi: मोटर न्यूरॉन रोग, मस्कुलर डिस्ट्रॉफी, या मांसपेशियों-तंत्रिका तंत्र की कोई बीमारी?
items.promptHinglish: Motor neuron disease, muscular dystrophy, ya muscles-nerves ki koi bimari?

items.label: neuro_psychiatric
items.prompt: Stroke, paralysis, transient ischaemic attack, multiple sclerosis, epilepsy, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, dementia, depression or any psychiatric illness?
items.promptHi: स्ट्रोक, पक्षाघात, मिर्गी, मल्टीपल स्क्लेरोसिस, पार्किंसन, अल्जाइमर, डिमेंशिया, अवसाद या कोई मानसिक बीमारी?
items.promptHinglish: Stroke, paralysis, mirgi, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, dementia, depression ya koi mental illness?

items.label: digestive_hepatic
items.prompt: Cirrhosis, hepatitis, pancreatitis, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, piles, or any condition of the liver, gall bladder, stomach or intestines?
items.promptHi: सिरोसिस, हेपेटाइटिस, पैंक्रियाटाइटिस, क्रोहन रोग, अल्सरेटिव कोलाइटिस, बवासीर, या लिवर, पित्ताशय, पेट या आंतों की कोई बीमारी?
items.promptHinglish: Cirrhosis, hepatitis, pancreatitis, Crohn's, colitis, piles, ya liver, gall bladder, pet ya intestine ki koi bimari?

items.label: renal_urological
items.prompt: Kidney stones, renal failure, dialysis, chronic kidney disease, prostate disease, or any condition of the kidney, urinary tract or reproductive organs?
items.promptHi: गुर्दे की पथरी, किडनी फेल्योर, डायलिसिस, क्रोनिक किडनी रोग, प्रोस्टेट, या मूत्र मार्ग या प्रजनन अंगों की कोई बीमारी?
items.promptHinglish: Kidney stone, kidney failure, dialysis, chronic kidney disease, prostate, ya urinary ya reproductive organs ki koi bimari?

items.label: haematological_immune_skin
items.prompt: HIV, lupus, arthritis, scleroderma, psoriasis, a bleeding or clotting disorder, or any condition of the blood, bone marrow, immunity or skin?
items.promptHi: एचआईवी, ल्यूपस, गठिया, स्क्लेरोडर्मा, सोरायसिस, रक्तस्राव विकार, या रक्त, अस्थि मज्जा, प्रतिरक्षा या त्वचा की कोई बीमारी?
items.promptHinglish: HIV, lupus, arthritis, scleroderma, psoriasis, bleeding disorder, ya blood, bone marrow, immunity ya skin ki koi bimari?
items.complianceNote: HIV status is sensitive personal data under DPDP; must be encrypted with the medical-data CMK and excluded from any non-underwriting projection.

items.label: ent_ophthalmic
items.prompt: Any disease of the eye, ear, nose or throat, other than sight corrected by glasses or lenses?
items.promptHi: आँख, कान, नाक या गले की कोई बीमारी, चश्मे से ठीक होने वाली दृष्टि को छोड़कर?
items.promptHinglish: Aankh, kaan, naak ya gale ki koi bimari, chashme se theek hone wali nazar ko chhod kar?

items.label: musculoskeletal
items.prompt: Any orthopaedic disorder, fracture or dislocation of bones or joints, avascular necrosis, or other musculoskeletal condition?
items.promptHi: कोई हड्डी या जोड़ों का विकार, फ्रैक्चर, अव्यवस्था, या मांसपेशी-हड्डी तंत्र की बीमारी?
items.promptHinglish: Koi haddi ya joint ka disorder, fracture, dislocation, ya musculoskeletal problem?

items.label: tobacco_use
items.prompt: Do you use tobacco in any form - cigarettes, bidi, gutkha, paan masala or chewing tobacco?
items.promptHi: क्या आप किसी भी रूप में तंबाकू का सेवन करते हैं - सिगरेट, बीड़ी, गुटखा, पान मसाला या खैनी?
items.promptHinglish: Kya aap kisi bhi form mein tobacco lete hain - cigarette, bidi, gutkha, paan masala ya khaini?
items.notes: Tobacco and alcohol are SEPARATE questions, as on the insurer's telephonic report. They were one combined item, which made a 'yes' unattributable: the two carry different loadings, and a rating cannot be built from an answer that could mean either.

items.label: tobacco_detail
items.prompt: Which form, roughly how much per day, and for how many years?
items.promptHi: किस रूप में, प्रतिदिन कितना, और कितने वर्षों से?
items.promptHinglish: Kis form mein, roz kitna, aur kitne saal se?

items.label: alcohol_use
items.prompt: And do you drink alcohol?
items.promptHi: और क्या आप शराब पीते हैं?
items.promptHinglish: Aur kya aap alcohol lete hain?

items.label: alcohol_detail
items.prompt: What do you usually drink, roughly how much per week, and for how many years?
items.promptHi: आप आमतौर पर क्या पीते हैं, सप्ताह में लगभग कितना, और कितने वर्षों से?
items.promptHinglish: Aap aam taur par kya peete hain, hafte mein kitna, aur kitne saal se?

items.label: hospitalised_or_treated
items.prompt: Have you ever been hospitalised, advised investigations or medication, been under prolonged treatment, or undergone surgery for any illness or injury, other than childbirth or minor injuries?
items.promptHi: क्या आप कभी अस्पताल में भर्ती हुए हैं, जाँच या दवा की सलाह दी गई है, लंबे इलाज पर रहे हैं, या किसी बीमारी या चोट के लिए सर्जरी हुई है, प्रसव या छोटी चोटों के अलावा?
items.promptHinglish: Kya aap kabhi hospital mein admit hue hain, koi test ya dawa advise hui hai, lambe treatment par rahe hain, ya kisi bimari ya chot ke liye surgery hui hai, delivery ya choti chot ke alawa?
items.notes: This is the question the mentor called out as needing depth. The four follow-ups below mirror what a doctor asks on the call: why, when, is it resolved, are you still medicated.

items.label: hospitalisation_reason
items.prompt: What was the reason for that?
items.promptHi: इसका कारण क्या था?
items.promptHinglish: Uska reason kya tha?

items.label: hospitalisation_when
items.prompt: When was that, approximately? A year is fine.
items.promptHi: यह लगभग कब हुआ था? वर्ष बता दें तो ठीक है।
items.promptHinglish: Yeh approximately kab hua tha? Saal bata dijiye.

items.label: condition_resolved
items.prompt: Has that condition fully resolved now?
items.promptHi: क्या वह स्थिति अब पूरी तरह ठीक हो गई है?
items.promptHinglish: Kya woh condition ab poori tarah theek ho gayi hai?

items.label: still_on_medication
items.prompt: Are you still taking any medication for it?
items.promptHi: क्या आप अभी भी इसके लिए कोई दवा ले रहे हैं?
items.promptHinglish: Kya aap abhi bhi iske liye koi dawa le rahe hain?

items.label: current_medication_list
items.prompt: Which medications, and what dosage if you know it?
items.promptHi: कौन सी दवाएँ, और खुराक क्या है यदि आपको पता है?
items.promptHinglish: Kaun si dawaiyan, aur dose kya hai agar aapko pata hai?

items.label: adverse_investigation
items.prompt: Has any medical test or investigation ever shown an abnormal result - a thyroid or lipid profile, treadmill test, angiography, echo, endoscopy, ultrasound, CT, MRI, biopsy or FNAC?
items.promptHi: क्या किसी जाँच या टेस्ट में कभी कोई असामान्य नतीजा आया है - थायरॉइड या लिपिड प्रोफ़ाइल, ट्रेडमिल टेस्ट, एंजियोग्राफी, इको, एंडोस्कोपी, अल्ट्रासाउंड, सीटी, एमआरआई, बायोप्सी या एफएनएसी?
items.promptHinglish: Kya kisi test ya investigation mein kabhi abnormal result aaya hai - thyroid ya lipid profile, treadmill test, angiography, echo, endoscopy, ultrasound, CT, MRI, biopsy ya FNAC?
items.notes: An ABNORMAL TEST WITHOUT A DIAGNOSIS is invisible to every other question on this form. The condition screens ask what the caller has been diagnosed with, and A500 asks about hospitalisation and treatment; a raised TSH or an incidental ultrasound finding that nobody has yet named is caught by neither, and it is exactly what underwriting wants to see.

items.label: adverse_investigation_detail
items.prompt: Which test was it, when, and what did it show?
items.promptHi: कौन सा टेस्ट था, कब हुआ, और उसमें क्या आया?
items.promptHinglish: Kaun sa test tha, kab hua, aur usme kya aaya?

items.label: family_history
items.prompt: Do you, or either of your parents, have any hereditary or genetic condition - such as colour blindness, haemophilia, thalassaemia, a birth defect, muscular dystrophy or lupus? Please include it even if someone was only a carrier.
items.promptHi: क्या आपको, या आपके माता-पिता में किसी को, कोई आनुवंशिक बीमारी है - जैसे वर्णांधता, हीमोफीलिया, थैलेसीमिया, जन्मजात विकार, मस्कुलर डिस्ट्रॉफी या ल्यूपस? कृपया बताएँ चाहे कोई केवल वाहक ही रहा हो।
items.promptHinglish: Kya aapko, ya aapke mummy-papa mein kisi ko, koi hereditary ya genetic bimari hai - jaise colour blindness, haemophilia, thalassaemia, birth defect, muscular dystrophy ya lupus? Carrier the tab bhi bataiye.
items.notes: FAMILY HISTORY WAS DETECTED AND THROWN AWAY. The orchestrator already recognises 'my father had diabetes' and deliberately refuses to record it as the caller's own diagnosis - correct, and it left the information nowhere to go, because nothing ever asked for it. This item is where it belongs. Deliberately NOT in the condition_detail group: a relative's illness must never open the caller's own clinical protocol.

items.label: family_history_detail
items.prompt: Which condition, and who in the family has it?
items.promptHi: कौन सी बीमारी, और परिवार में किसे है?
items.promptHinglish: Kaun si bimari, aur family mein kisko hai?

items.label: prior_insurance_decision
items.prompt: Has any insurer ever declined, postponed or loaded a life, health or critical illness proposal for you, or accepted it with special conditions or exclusions?
items.promptHi: क्या किसी बीमा कंपनी ने कभी आपके जीवन, स्वास्थ्य या गंभीर बीमारी के प्रस्ताव को मना किया, टाला, अधिक प्रीमियम लगाया, या किसी शर्त या अपवाद के साथ स्वीकार किया है?
items.promptHinglish: Kya kisi insurance company ne kabhi aapka life, health ya critical illness proposal decline kiya, postpone kiya, extra premium lagaya, ya kisi condition ya exclusion ke saath accept kiya hai?
items.notes: A prior adverse underwriting decision is disclosable in its own right and points at history the caller may not think of as illness. Absent from this form until now.

items.label: prior_insurance_detail
items.prompt: Which insurer, roughly when, and what reason were you given?
items.promptHi: कौन सी बीमा कंपनी, लगभग कब, और आपको क्या कारण बताया गया?
items.promptHinglish: Kaun si insurance company, lagbhag kab, aur aapko kya reason bataya gaya?

items.label: any_other_condition
items.prompt: Finally, any other disease, health condition, injury or treatment that we have not covered?
items.promptHi: अंत में, कोई अन्य बीमारी, स्वास्थ्य समस्या, चोट या इलाज जिसकी हमने चर्चा नहीं की?
items.promptHinglish: Last mein, koi aur bimari, health problem, chot ya treatment jiski humne baat nahi ki?

items.label: other_condition_detail
items.prompt: Please tell me about it.
items.promptHi: कृपया इसके बारे में बताएँ।
items.promptHinglish: Kripya iske baare mein bataiye.

items.label: abha_number
items.prompt: Do you have an ABHA health ID number you would like on record? You can read it out, or just say no.
items.promptHi: क्या आपके पास ABHA स्वास्थ्य आईडी नंबर है जो रिकॉर्ड में रखना चाहेंगे? नंबर बता दीजिए, या नहीं कह दीजिए।
items.promptHinglish: Kya aapke paas ABHA health ID number hai jo record mein rakhna chahenge? Number bata dijiye, ya nahi keh dijiye.
items.notes: ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) is the Indian national health ID. Optional on the form. The prompt offers 'no', not 'skip': the question is phrased as a yes/no question, so 'no' is what a caller reaches for, and a live call answered it with नहीं twice. 'skip' is still accepted by extract._ABHA_DECLINE, it is just no longer the only word offered.

items.label: email_confirm
items.prompt: That is everything. I will email a summary to {{customerEmail}} and you will have 48 hours to correct anything. Is that the right address?
items.promptHi: बस इतना ही। मैं {{customerEmail}} पर सारांश भेज दूँगा और आपके पास 48 घंटे होंगे कुछ भी ठीक करने के लिए। क्या यह पता सही है?
items.promptHinglish: Bas itna hi. Main {{customerEmail}} par summary bhej dunga aur aapke paas 48 ghante honge kuch bhi correct karne ke liye. Kya yeh address sahi hai?
items.complianceNote: The 48-hour correction window is the SLA stated by the customer.

condition_detail.description: Applied by the agent whenever any A2xx/A3xx condition answer is yes. Sourced from Neptune so the medical team can change the protocol without a model redeployment.

questions.label: current_treatment
questions.prompt: What treatment or medication are you on for it?

questions.label: is_controlled
questions.prompt: Is it well controlled at the moment?

questions.label: last_consultation
questions.prompt: When did you last see a doctor about it?

questions.label: complications
questions.prompt: Have there been any complications or hospital admissions from it?
